AI_ENGINE_ISOLATED_READ_PATHS is set from that string at line 695. Inside claude_run, the read profile path calls _ai_engine_claude_run_isolated, which calls _ai_engine_isolation_preflight. The preflight at lines 220-222 unconditionally rejects non-empty AI_ENGINE_ISOLATED_READ_PATHS with isolation_read_path_invalid, causing fallback to 75 and the codex path. The advertised WORKFLOW_HEAL Claude cutover is never reached when source or branch-tip checkouts exist.
  SOURCE: `Line or code reference: lines 688-691 passing through to ai_engine.sh:220-223`
- tests/test_claude_engine_utility_roles.py | severity=high | confidence=5

  WHY: The four heal-integrity tests pass with empty heal_read_paths, so they do not exercise the isolation preflight rejection.

Suggested minimal fix: Change the match to check Path(command[0]).name in {"bash", "sh"} or use command[0].endswith("/bash") or command[0].endswith("/sh"). `HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1` `Estimated lines changed: 1`

Suggested minimal fix: Check len(command) >= 2 and command[1] == "-c" and Path(command[0]).name in ("bash", "sh") instead of command[:2] == ["bash", "-c"]. `estimated lines changed: 1` `HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1`

=== FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
- Requirement: The PR description states that `WORKFLOW_HEAL` (`workflow-failure-heal-intake.yml`) moves to the Claude engine under Phase 5d, with the documented fallback being a transient CLI/credential failure ("Exit 75 (role on codex, Claude unavailable, or no engine) runs the unchanged codex call below").
  Expected change site: scripts/workflow_failure_heal_intake.sh around lines 680-697 (the new `heal_claude_rc` block, specifically the `AI_ENGINE_ISOLATED_READ_PATHS="${heal_isolated_paths}"` export), in coordination with the read-profile preflight in scripts/ai_engine.sh around lines 220-223 (the `[ -n "${AI_ENGINE_ISOLATED_READ_PATHS:-}" ]` guard) and the fallback return at lines 299-300.
  Evidence of absence: When `${HEAL_SOURCE_DIR}` or `${HEAL_BRANCH_TIP_DIR}` is a directory, the shell populates `heal_read_paths` and exports a non-empty `AI_ENGINE_ISOLATED_READ_PATHS` to the Claude invocation. The read-profile preflight in ai_engine.sh rejects any non-empty `AI_ENGINE_ISOLATED_READ_PATHS` with `AI_ENGINE_ISOLATION_FAILURE=isolation_read_path_invalid`, which routes through the Claude-unavailable fallback. The heal script never falls through to the post-Claude integrity guard or the codex path cleanly; it just returns 75 from claude_run_selected. Net effect: WORKFLOW_HEAL silently runs on codex for every heal intake that has either worktree present, which is the common case (the workflow failure heal intake stages the source checkout and the branch-tip worktree precisely to give the model a readable view). The two new tests added in the LAST RUN DIFF (test_heal_claude_tampered_support_is_rejected and test_heal_claude_rejects_invalid_support) cover the integrity guard but not the `AI_ENGINE_ISOLATED_READ_PATHS` preflight path, so the regression is not caught. No test currently exercises the heal block with `HEAL_SOURCE_DIR` set, and the PR has no entry addressing the conflict.
  SEVERITY: high | confidence=5
- HARDENING_SUGGESTION: `File: tests/test_claude_engine_utility_roles.py` `Location: run_with_invalid_support wrapper inside test_heal_claude_rejects_invalid_support (the new parametrized test), where the injection is gated on if command[:2] == ["bash", "-c"]:` If production switches to `/bin/bash -c`, `sh -c`, or a single-string subprocess.run form, the cases can fall through to the unpatched subprocess.run and the regression may go undetected. Suggested minimal fix: Broaden the gate to `isinstance(command, list) and len(command) >= 2 and command[1] == "-c" and Path(command[0]).name in {"bash", "sh"}`, and as a separate branch handle `isinstance(command, str) and command.lstrip().startswith(("bash ", "sh ", "/bin/bash ", "/bin/sh "))`. `Estimated lines changed: 5` `HARDENING_RISK_SCORE: 1`

=== END FINDINGS FROM minimax_minimax-m3 ===
